observed_problem: The generic Retrospective Period helper validates that start <= end but does not require the Profile as_of/initialization instant to be at or after the bounded period end. A custom or future configured retrospective can therefore initialize while part of its declared period is still in the future.
expected_behavior: RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD represents completed bounded history. Deterministic initialization must fail closed unless as_of is at or after the period end. This is analogous to Weekly refusing an issue whose configured editorial cutoff has not yet occurred.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Require as_of >= bounded-period end before Profile creation/initialization and add a regression rejecting incomplete future periods.
